note: Trigger-routing suite. expect=trigger: the skill should fire on the prompt in a fresh session; expect=no-trigger: a near-miss owned elsewhere (owner in comment). Convertible to skill-creator's eval format; run via its description-tuning loop or manual fresh-session baseline. t04 rephrased 2026-07-09: 'Improve this prompt brief' was itself the ambiguity — 'prompt' reads as an instruction artifact (prompt-wording-rules' territory) in 3 of 4 blind runs; the case now tests the ask-sharpening reading it was written for. t06/t07 added 2026-08-17 (issue #479, #295's ablation finding): rt1-class raw under-specified asks with no meta-language died to none/plugin-install-facts at baseline — the description previously only caught requests that named intent-extraction outright. n06/n07 added the same change as no-theft guards: a request that's small but already fully scoped must not be swept in by the broadened wording.

cases.prompt: What am I really asking for here?
Figure out what they actually want from this ticket
Clarify this request before we build it
Improve this feature brief before we build it
This spec is vague — extract the real intent
Write the PRD for this feature
Interview me for a new skill's requirements
Break this system down into components
is this refactor actually improving things or just reorganizing them
Before we wrap up, is there anything still open?
cases.comment: owner: find-open-questions — sweeping a session's already-raised unresolved items closed, not sharpening a not-yet-started ask

cases.prompt: Make our plugins easier for people to get started with.

rt1-class: same shape as t06, shorter — a bare goal with nothing to anchor scope or done

cases.prompt: Add a dark mode toggle to the settings page that persists to localStorage.
